Package dev.opencollab.paletter.item

Class ItemRegistry.Builder

java.lang.Object
dev.opencollab.paletter.item.ItemRegistry.Builder
Enclosing class:
ItemRegistry
@Internal public static final class ItemRegistry.Builder extends Object
Builds an item palette. Obtained from ItemRegistry.vanilla(dev.opencollab.paletter.internal.data.VanillaData, java.util.List<dev.opencollab.paletter.internal.data.VanillaItem>, dev.opencollab.paletter.block.BlockRegistry, dev.opencollab.paletter.internal.CanonicalItems) or ItemRegistry.extend(dev.opencollab.paletter.block.BlockRegistry, dev.opencollab.paletter.internal.CanonicalItems); used by the palette compiler.

    • keepsCreativeStacksOfParent

      public void keepsCreativeStacksOfParent()
      Says that the layout build(dev.opencollab.paletter.creative.CreativeLayout, dev.opencollab.paletter.internal.PaletteReportBuilder) gets has the creative stacks of the parent's items as the parent's layout does, apart from the items this builder registers or overrides (a layer without creative edits): the default blocks of the other items are the parent's, and are not decided again. Without it every item is decided again. The layout is walked for the changed items.

    • keepsCreativeStacksOfParentLayout

      public void keepsCreativeStacksOfParentLayout(@NonNull Set<String> mentioned)
      Like keepsCreativeStacksOfParent() for a layout that is the parent's itself, whose identifiers are known: the layout is not walked at all if it mentions none of the changed items.
      Parameters:
      mentioned - the identifiers the parent's layout mentions
